name: core retrieval and abstention
description: Deterministic retrieval checks. Positive cases assert that the distinctive piece of evidence is retrieved; negative cases assert that an entity absent from the corpus is NOT retrieved, which is what forces the assistant to abstain instead of inventing an answer.
